question: A can do a piece of work in 12 days, B can do the same work in 15 days. C can do the same work in 9 days. The time taken by them to finish the same work if they work together is:
solution:
**Given:**

A can do a piece of work in 12 days.

B can do the same work in 15 days.

C can do the same work in 9 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done together in one day = 1/A + 1/B + 1/C

Time taken to complete the work together = 1 / (Work done together in one day)

**Calculation:**

Work done by A in one day = 1/12

Work done by B in one day = 1/15

Work done by C in one day = 1/9

Work done together in one day:

⇒ Work done together in one day = (1/12) + (1/15) + (1/9)

⇒ Work done together in one day = (15 + 12 + 20) / 180

⇒ Work done together in one day = 47 / 180

Time taken to complete the work together:

⇒ Time taken to complete the work together = 1 / (47/180)

⇒ Time taken to complete the work together = 180 / 47

⇒ Time taken to complete the work together ≈ 3(39)/(47) days

**The time taken by A, B, and C to finish the work together is 3(39)/(47)** **days.**
